title: Which Sidekick Energy Do You Have?
description: Heroes get the statues, but sidekicks make the story. Which legendary second-in-command are you?

answers.text: 'Say less. Picking you up in ten.'
'The last plan got us banned from mini-golf. I'm in.'
'Send details. I'll make a doc.'
'Walk me through it first. Slowly.'

questions.text: The credits roll on your story. Your title card reads:

answers.text: 'The Funny One (Emotionally Essential)'
'The Brains of the Operation'
'The Reason Everyone Survived'
'The Plot Twist'

results.description: Officially the funny one; unofficially the emotional backbone. Your jokes arrive exactly when the story needs them, and everyone breathes easier because you exist.
Loyalty with a seatbelt on. You show up first, stay longest, and never ask why — your friendship is the one thing in the story that's never in doubt.
Quiet, unassuming, catastrophically underestimated. You spend most of the story in the background — right up until the moment you casually save everything.
The one in the chair, and proud of it. Every plan works because you did the homework, built the tools, and thought of the thing nobody else thought of.
The sigh before the adventure and the reason everyone comes home. You see the flaws in every plan, say so, and then loyally help anyway. Heroic, honestly.
